name: calortracker-food-nutrition
title: CalorTracker Food Nutrition Dataset (USDA-derived)
description: 461 common foods with nutrients per 100 g and household portions, taken from USDA FoodData Central and keyed by FDC id and CalorTracker page slug.

resources.name: foods
resources.description: One row per food: identity, USDA source and 31 nutrients per 100 g.
